verdict.rationale: Skyfire scopes each API key to a single agent (Buyer or Seller) and lets you restrict an agent's source IP addresses. The credentials agents actually present, pay and kya-pay tokens, are least-privilege by design: each is capped at a committed amount, expires in 10 seconds to 24 hours, and discloses only the identity fields a service requires. missing for 10: fine-grained permission scopes on API keys beyond per-agent binding, a per-token revocation API (in-flight tokens survive account deactivation), independent or hands-on corroboration.
